blindness_caveat: A general web search for 'Netflix mergers acquisitions history gaming studios' returned only gaming-studio acquisition coverage (Night School Studio, Next Games, Boss Fight, Spry Fox) with no exposure to any Warner Bros. Discovery filing text. A SEPARATE, later search specifically about the WBD situation (prompted by a gaming-studio article's own aside referencing it) surfaced the deal's news coverage AND, in one result, a snippet of the real Item 1.01 8-K text (from a search-engine-rendered SEC filing page) before the full text was deliberately fetched for extraction testing. The gold event below is dated/scoped from Warner Bros. Discovery's and Netflix's own investor-relations press releases and CNBC, not from that incidental filing-text exposure.
note: Seventh and final untested company from the original list. By far the most structurally complex real transaction tested this session -- more so than Paramount/Skydance: a three-step structure (Holdco Merger under DGCL Section 251(g), then WBD's internal separation of its Global Linear Networks business into a standalone SpinCo, then the actual Netflix-WBD merger), four real named entities (Netflix, Nightingale Sub Inc. [Merger Sub], WBD, New Topco 25 Inc. [Newco]), $82.7B enterprise value -- the largest deal value tested by a wide margin. IMPORTANT REAL-WORLD COMPLICATION, confirmed via Wikipedia: this specific Netflix-WBD merger agreement was later TERMINATED. Paramount Skydance launched a rival unsolicited tender offer on 2025-12-08, revised it repeatedly, and on 2026-02-26 WBD's board determined Paramount's revised $110.9B offer was superior; Netflix declined to match and withdrew, and Paramount Skydance proceeded as the winning bidder instead (expected to close Sept-Dec 2026). The AGREED_TO_ACQUIRE event below is scored COMPLETED in the same sense used throughout this project's gold files -- the agreement was genuinely signed on 2025-12-04 -- not a claim that the underlying merger itself ever closed. No ACQUIRED/closing gold event is included for this deal, and none ever will exist: the merger never happened. This is a fundamentally different kind of 'the second event is missing' than every other company tested (where the closing may simply not have been fetched yet) -- here there is no closing to ever find.

events.notes: Definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger signed; $82.7B enterprise value ($72.0B equity value), $23.25 cash + $4.50 in Netflix stock per WBD share. Terminated 2026-02-26 when Netflix declined to match Paramount Skydance's superior competing offer -- see note.
